about_the_game:
You are a worker who's been called to maintain and complete tasks in a complex of the Street 42, you get to complete tasks such as destroying cursed clocks that set you back, fix fuses, set alarms, fix TVs and finally as the final task you'll get to find the real reason why you're there, the unwavering company of your fella will help you navigate your traumas. 😈

Now the questions I've got for you are...

1️⃣ Are you prepared for this?

2️⃣ Do you think it's that easy?

Have a go! in about 35-55 minutes of completion, come back and tell me how it did go.

Features ✨

  • Single-Player Experience you'll be playing as a true-first-person controller.

  • Incredibly Advanced AIs with up to 5 different Animated AIs with different abilities such as Crawling creatures,  Environmental manipulation AIs, Psychological nightmares that are able to hear but unable to see, Stop-on-sight enemy and of course... The final boss you'll meet yourself. Also, did i forget to mention that they know your name?

  • AIs breakdown

    • ► Nana: From every corner, she's right there awaiting for your moves. (Available in the Full Version)

      ► FlickerMan: From the creepy hallways, he's capable of moving fast while the light cuts off. (Available in the Full Version)

      ► Echo: From the silent hallways, he's blind but not deaf, he's capable of hearing everything, including your breath. (Available in the Full Version)

      ► Glare: From tension and stealth, he's fast and when you look away, that's your end. (Available in the Full Version)

      ► Mara: From the last and darkest night shift, there's nothing you can do but pray out. (Available in the Full Version)

  • Auto-Saved Levels with features like this, you'll be able to continue your current level you've previously unlocked. (Keep in mind that this doesn't mean there's checkpoints on each level individually)

  • Multi-Language System we have up to 3 available languages on this version of the game, English 🇺🇸, Spanish 🇺🇪🇸 and Portuguese 🇺🇪🇧🇷. We support these 3 languages on both texts and audios.

  • Dynamic Voice Lines one of the biggest features out there! Imagine continuous narrations from both, your NPC and the AIs with smart audios triggered by your own events.

  • Dynamic Environment a wrong step and the AIs know you're there... On the other hand, imagine a soothing rain from indoors and a stormy rain outside, well, this is the case my friend.

  • Settings 1- you like to feel the old retro vibe? that's an option for you. 2- don't like your inputs on your keyboard? that's customizable.

  • Regular updates, additional levels, and planned online Co-Op features (unlocked once the community reaches 500k players). 🚀

  • ► Survival Tips

  • Listen to what Bob (Ai companion) says 🗣️ Each line he says it's highly recommended hear since every action you perform such as opening doors could cut important phrases you need to hear to stay alert, the tutorial - walkthrough comes mostly from audios, not UIs.

  • If you found a flashlight 🔦 and picked it up, you can use it against her. It makes her scream and laugh, during those animations you can escape.

  • You can hide in the closets 🚪 to make her go back to patrol.

  • If you hold E you slam the doors ❌ and she hears you, it's critical to dynamically tap it several times to open it safely. ✅

    ► Requirements

    • 965.28 MB Space Required.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7, 8, 10, 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 or AMD FX-4300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti or AMD Radeon R7 260X (or Intel HD 4000 integrated)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Lower settings recommended for integrated graphics.

short_description: Street 42 is a short psychological true first person horror game where you play as a worker, your job is to end what your friend couldn't.
supported_languages:
English*, Spanish - Spain*, Portuguese - Brazil*, Portuguese - Portugal*
*languages with full audio support
